title: Al Quran
body:
Al Quran
Aa oozoo billahi minash shaytanir rajim. (Bismillah hir-rahman nir rahim) x2 Inna nahno nazzal na zikra wa inna lahu la hafizun

<<DIVIDER>>
Bismi rabbi jaha bismillah. Subhanallah ye quran allah allah. Ummul kitaab-e he ye mashallah, ik ik surah he universalloh.
Quran ki god ka ek ek surah. Wo ma-aaeda hu ki yasin wa taha. Sura-e maryam wa rehman wa shora. Parte hi rehtehe rab ka kasida.
Quran ki he shaan he shaane muhammed. Quran he mizan-e muhammed. Farma ne rab farma ne muhammed. Nukta-e baa quran-e muhammed.
Kaise quran he hum tak aaya. Kisne sikhaaya he kisne parhaaya. He kis gara ne ka ye sarmaya. Jan deke isko he kisne bachaaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Din bhi bacha quran bhi dekho. Baki raha imaan bhi maano. Kiya gaya kiska ye bhi to socho. Gar to luta sayada ka hai logo
Wo karbala wo nabi ka gar aana. Quran idhar to udhar he zamaana. Ik ik par-e ka maqtal jaana. Khun me nahaa ke ye sab ko bataa na
Ye karbala ye he shaam-e ghariba. Wo jalte khayme wo aayate Quran Khaymo me bali sakina pareshan. Zainab pukari ye barsare mayda
<<MINI>>
